title: Snake Tongue 솔로 #193 · 가나·에메랄드 나무뱀(트리 보아) 눈·눈 강조·혀 와인 보라·독니 금 캡+루비 · P50 · 뱀 추 없음 · 배경 스튜디오 짙은 남색 · 기반 `la_facesculpt_064`
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, close-up beauty portrait. ONE woman, facing the camera straight on in a perfectly frontal portrait, her head level, both ears clearly visible on either side of her face, framed tightly from the very top of her head down to the line of her shoulders, the frame cutting off just below them, so the weights fully hang in view. Her face is large and sharp. Mid 30s.

Subject: A striking adult Ghanaian woman — Ghanaian elegant beauty with deep, rich blue-black skin and real visible pores, mid 30s, a short cropped natural afro with both ears visible, a full makeup: a matte base, sharp contour, long lashes and glossy black lipstick, real emerald tree boa eyes: large glossy lime-green irises with a razor-thin vertical slit pupil, jet black, running the full height of each eye, both eyes the same, the colour solidly saturated across the whole iris with a darker ring around its edge, a wet glassy shine on the surface of each eye, set in her ordinary human eyelids and sitting clear of the eyelid edges, a fierce, intense stare — a photograph of a real Ghanaian woman's face, not an illustration, not a render. Her face is natural and beautiful: a slim diamond-shaped face with high cheekbones, a slender nose and a wide, expressive mouth. Face irezumi: a traditional Japanese irezumi tattoo in bold black ink outlines with vivid colour fills covers her forehead: a coiling snake in jade green and gold with black-edged scales and red peonies, its body winding across the whole forehead from one temple to the other, its head raised at the centre of the forehead above the brows; it is real tattooed skin with the pores and peach-fuzz visible through the ink, the piercings, henna and stickers sit on top of the inked skin wherever they overlap, and her eyes, eyelids and lips stay bare real skin. Eyeshadow: her eyeshadow is a snake-scale makeup in lime green, emerald and gold, a smooth gradient across the whole eyelid from the lash line up to the brow bone, with a sharp, narrow, upswept winged liner in a black-green that ends in a long fine point at the outer corner and a faint shimmer of tiny scale-like glitter on the outer third of the lid; it sits on the lids as ordinary eyeshadow on her real skin with the pores and peach-fuzz visible, and the eyeballs and lashes stay natural. Her brows are bare like the Mona Lisa's: the whole brow bone is smooth, hairless skin in the same tone as her forehead, with only the soft natural curve of the brow ridge showing, her forehead high, smooth and serene. Her lips are slightly parted and a real snake's tongue slides out through the gap between them and extends far out: an extremely thin, round, smooth cord as slim as a shoelace from its base to its tips, split from the tips back almost to its base into two hair-fine, needle-sharp prongs, each as fine as a thick strand of hair, held in a narrow V in the air and hanging well past her chin down to the base of her throat, deep wine-purple, glossy and wet-looking like a real snake's tongue, the whole thin tongue clearly visible against her skin and in sharp focus. Her lips part wide enough to show two long, slender, curved venomous fangs that descend from her upper jaw on either side of the centre, sheathed in polished gold from the gum up to just short of its ivory-white needle-sharp tip, a small round ruby set into the gold near the base of each fang, glossy and wet-looking, each as long as her lower lip is tall and tapering to a needle-sharp point, in sharp focus beside the tongue. Her whole face, ears and neck are real living skin with visible pores and faint peach-fuzz hairs, slightly asymmetrical with one or two small natural beauty marks, never airbrushed and never smooth like plastic, an uneven natural skin tone with a faint flush across the cheeks and around the nostrils, tiny visible pores on the nose and chin and fine natural vertical lines in the lips, real wet catchlights in the eyes and individual hair strands catching the light. Her shoulders, collarbones and upper chest are real living skin too, with visible pores, fine skin grain, faint peach-fuzz and a soft natural sheen of skin oils, her skin tone varying naturally across the collarbones and shoulders. Her face has been surgically sculpted far beyond her natural look, and these changes override her natural features: her eyes are the star of her face (the shape, size and lenses described here override the eyes of her makeup, while her eyeshadow is the animal-scale makeup described above): extreme siren eyes: very long, very narrow, strongly upturned eyes with the outer corners lifted high and stretched far out toward the temples ; her nose: a refined nose; her jawline and chin: a soft, round 'baby face' jaw: full, plump, rounded cheeks, a short, soft, rounded jawline with no sharp angles and a small, round, slightly full chin. Every feature is exaggerated but beautiful, balanced and refined, in harmony with the rest of her face, never distorted, never grotesque.

Piercings: A face fully covered with real piercings, about forty in total (not counting the hanging weights), spread over every area so that no area is empty: a single large septum ring of different sizes and shapes through the thin soft wall between the nostrils, in a short stack that ends above the upper lip; one small ring wrapping snugly around each nostril wing; two small hoop or studs along the edge of the upper lip; four small hoop or studs across the lower lip's edge; two small ring or studs on the chin; on each ear, one large healed opening in the earlobe holding a very thick, heavy black cast-iron ring as thick as a finger, a plain solid ring with no open tunnel, and above it sit seven pieces above the lobe: four classic round O-rings and studs along the helix rim, two studs and small bars across the upper cartilage and one in the conch and tragus; five small studs across the lower half of the forehead just above the brows in even rows, leaving the upper forehead free; four small studs along each cheekbone, well clear of the eyes. The left and right sides are balanced. The pieces are spread over the whole face in clear rows so every one reads individually, with bare skin between them; the eyes and eyelids stay clear. All the ear weights hang from the bottoms of this iron ring, and they are not counted in the piercing total: on each ear there are exactly eight separate massive weights, each of a different shape and a different metal, all of them rough, hammered, matte and unpolished, each hanging on its own thick heavy chain of the same metal as the weight: on the left ear dark patinated bronze a bell-shaped weight like a small temple bell with a flared rim on a shortest chain, tarnished dark silver a miniature anvil on a shortest chain, dull pewter-grey tin a hammer head on a short chain, dull blue-grey lead a pyramid-shaped lump on a medium chain, oxidized dark copper a barrel-shaped weight on a long chain, rough-cast matte yellow gold a round bell on a long chain, dull dark brass a cube-shaped block on a longer chain, blackened cast iron a chunky hexagonal nut-shaped weight with a round hole through the centre on a longest chain; on the right ear dull dark brass a bell-shaped weight like a small temple bell with a flared rim on a shortest chain, rough-cast matte yellow gold a square-sided cowbell on a shortest chain, tarnished dark silver a hammer head on a short chain, dull blue-grey lead a chunky hexagonal nut-shaped weight with a round hole through the centre on a medium chain, dull pewter-grey tin a teardrop-shaped sinker on a long chain, blackened cast iron a round bell on a long chain, oxidized dark copper a barrel-shaped weight on a longer chain, dark patinated bronze a cube-shaped block on a longest chain. On each ear the single iron ring carries all the weights, hanging in a staggered cluster on chains of different lengths and staggered at different heights so every weight is fully visible and none hides another. Every single weight is a massive, dense, solid lump of metal at least as big as her whole fist and clearly larger than her earlobe, rough and matte and unpolished with no shine and no delicate or thin parts; its size does NOT shrink just because there are many of them: the last weight is exactly as big, as thick and as heavy-looking as the first. Each weight alone looks like it weighs several kilograms, each chain is pulled bar-straight and taut, and at a glance every single one looks crushingly, unmistakably heavy, the chains hanging freely in the air, clear of her neck and shoulders, with even the longest chain and its weight ending no lower than the level of her collarbones, never below them and never resting on her chest or body. Because all the load is carried by one opening, the weight gently pulls each earlobe down a little into a slightly elongated, soft, healthy loop of skin, only a small natural droop that is just enough to show how heavy the weights are; the lobe never stretches long, never tears or collapses and never hangs down to her neck or shoulder, her head stays upright, and the skin stays smooth and intact, fully healed, with no tearing, no wound, no blood and no redness. The face and ear jewelry is real mixed yellow gold, silver and rose gold set with glossy multicoloured enamel and rainbow gemstones, while the hanging weights are always rough, matte, unpolished heavy metal in mixed materials (lead, tin, gold, silver, bronze, copper, brass and iron), sitting in real, calm, healthy skin — no redness, no swelling, no irritation — with a small natural warm shadow under each piece. Every piece stays at least a finger's width from the eyeballs, and no chain or bar crosses the eyes.

Piercing depth: every bar and surface bar is embedded in the skin — its middle runs beneath the skin so only its two end studs show on the surface, the skin between them faintly raised over the hidden bar, with a small warm shadow at each end and nothing lying on top of the skin like a sticker. Every ring passes through a small healed opening in the skin, the skin visible through the loop, and every stud sits through the skin with its back hidden. Where a bar, ring or stud goes through the ear, the lip, the nostril or the brow, it passes through the real tissue with the skin wrapping snugly around it.

Hair: her hair is swept back behind both ears, leaving both ears, her jawline and her neck fully visible so every hanging piece is in clear view.

Lighting: A plain seamless deep midnight-navy backdrop, nothing else in frame, no texture, no gradient. The background colours are cool, mid-to-dark tones clearly different from her skin tone, never beige, peach, orange or brown, and never bright. A soft frontal light on her face and ears, so the glints on every piece of metal read clearly against her skin; a thin cool rim light along the hair and shoulders. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait.
